mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_post_vote (post_id, question, multiple_choice) VALUES (#{postId}, #{question}, #{multipleChoice})
INSERT INTO project_post_vote_option (vote_id, option_text, order_no) VALUES (#{voteId}, #{optionText}, #{orderNo})
mapper.select: SELECT vote_id FROM project_post_vote WHERE post_id = #{postId}
SELECT option_id, vote_id, option_text, order_no FROM project_post_vote_option WHERE vote_id = #{voteId} ORDER BY order_no
